title: Catalog: methods
purpose: Browse separately identified method versions, their tests and work usage, and start a new version without rewriting existing work.

sections.title: Access and navigation
paragraphs: Active staff with a laboratory role can read the lists. Client portal accounts cannot. Only the admin role creates or edits catalog records.

items.label: Tests
items.description: Combinations of analyte, method version and matrix available for requesting work.

items.label: Methods
items.description: Laboratory method versions that tests and batches refer to.

items.label: Analytes
items.description: Substances or properties measured by tests.

items.label: New method
items.description: Administrators create a method with an initial version.

items.label: Method version row link
items.description: Administrators open the selected version’s edit form.

items.label: New version
items.description: Administrators create a version based on this row, with optional test copies and predecessor retirement.

items.label: Spreadsheet import
items.description: Administrators can also create or change many method versions at once from a CSV file under Setup → Spreadsheet import, with a row-by-row preview and the same checks, locks and history as this form.

items.label: Search
items.description: Searches code, version, title and source/SOP reference; not reference source or technique, which have their own filters.

items.label: Method code
items.description: Exact existing code, spanning its versions.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active or Inactive refers to the version; blank includes both.

items.label: Reference source
items.description: More filters: one publisher from the fixed list. Versions with Not recorded match only when the filter is blank.

items.label: Technique
items.description: More filters: one technique from the fixed list. Versions with Not recorded match only when the filter is blank.

items.label: Used by work
items.description: More filters: Yes requires an analytical batch or received requested test using this version. No means both counts are zero. Other dependencies can still lock editing.

items.label: Method version
items.description: Code and version. Default sort is code ascending, then record ID.

items.label: Title
items.description: Laboratory name for this version.

items.label: Technique
items.description: Measurement technique recorded on the version, or a dash when not recorded. Sortable by its stored value, so the order follows the internal choice value rather than the displayed name.

items.label: Active tests
items.description: Number of definitions flagged active out of all definitions for this version; it does not check the method flag.

items.label: Status
items.description: Availability for new work; inactivation preserves existing references.

items.label: Source
items.description: Initially hidden citation or SOP reference. Expand long text for the full value.

items.label: Reference source
items.description: Initially hidden publisher of the method, or a dash when not recorded. Sortable by its stored value, so the order follows the internal choice value rather than the displayed name.

items.label: Used by work
items.description: Initially hidden sum of analytical batches and requested tests; hover text separates the counts. It is not a sample count or all-dependencies count.

items.label: Last changed
items.description: Initially hidden timestamp of the version’s latest audit event, or a dash.

sections.title: Using the table
paragraphs: Invalid filters leave the table empty with errors until corrected or cleared. A no-match state differs from an empty catalog. Administrators see the relevant New action in an empty catalog.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Combines search and filters across all records and starts at page 1. Search is case-insensitive and matches contained text.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Opens additional criteria and stays open when they are used or invalid.

items.label: Clear all and filter chips
items.description: Clear all restores the unfiltered URL and default sort. Removing one chip clears that criterion and starts at page 1 while keeping the other criteria.

items.label: Column headings
items.description: Linked headings sort the full filtered set; record ID breaks ties. Unsupported sort values fall back to the default.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show, hide or reorder optional columns; the identifying column stays visible. Preferences are saved for your account, on any workstation. Reset restores the default presentation without changing records or filters.

items.label: Rows per page and pagination
items.description: Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows; use Show if automatic submission is unavailable. A size change starts at page 1. First, Previous, Next and Last preserve filters and sort; the result count describes the filtered set.

items.label: Column checkboxes
items.description: Changes apply immediately. Check to show an optional column or uncheck to hide it. Always shown columns are fixed.

items.label: Move column up / down
items.description: Moves an optional column within the displayed order; the first/last position disables the unavailable move. You can also drag movable table headers.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restores this table’s default order and visibility for your account.

items.label: Done / Close
items.description: Closes the dialog; layout changes have already been applied and saved locally. No laboratory record is changed.
